cards.definitionEn: A slip of paper; a short note.
cards.exampleEn: Let me check my schedule before confirming our next lesson.

cards.definitionEn: To make (something) better; to increase the value or productivity (of something).
cards.exampleEn: Buying more servers would improve performance.

cards.definitionEn: An action performed on a regular basis.
cards.exampleEn: It’s become a habit of mine to have a cup of coffee after dinner.

cards.definitionEn: To make plain, manifest, or intelligible; to clear of obscurity; to illustrate the meaning of.
cards.exampleEn: To explain a chapter of the Bible.

cards.definitionEn: A person in whom one can confide or share one's secrets: a friend.
cards.exampleEn: She feels much more confident speaking English during team calls.

cards.definitionEn: To bestow commendation on; to represent favourably; to suggest, endorse or encourage as an appropriate choice.
cards.exampleEn: The board recommends Philips, given his ample experience in similar positions.

cards.definitionEn: The act of appointing a person to hold an office or to have a position of trust
cards.exampleEn: His appointment was deemed suitable

cards.definitionEn: Such as one may avail oneself of; capable of being used for the accomplishment of a purpose.
cards.exampleEn: We have an available candidate.

cards.definitionEn: Critical assessment of a process or activity or of their results.
cards.exampleEn: After you hand in your essays, I will give both grades and feedback.

cards.definitionEn: A continuous variable, especially one with respect to time in Newton's Method of Fluxions.
cards.exampleEn: He became fluent after six months of consistent 1-on-1 practice.

cards.meaningVi: cộng tác, phối hợp làm việc
cards.definitionEn: To work together with others to achieve a common goal.
cards.exampleEn: Let's collaborate on this project, and get it finished faster.

cards.definitionEn: A time limit in the form of a date on or before which something must be completed.
cards.exampleEn: I must make this deadline or my boss will kill me!

cards.definitionEn: (of liquids, such as wine or syrup) To make clear or bright by freeing from feculent matter
cards.exampleEn: Could you clarify what the client expects in the second milestone?

cards.meaningVi: sự ưu tiên, việc ưu tiên hàng đầu
cards.definitionEn: An item's relative importance.
cards.exampleEn: He set his e-mail message's priority to high.

cards.definitionEn: To make someone believe, or feel sure about something, especially by using logic, argument or evidence.
cards.exampleEn: I wouldn't have or do something, unless I'm convinced that it's good.
cards.contextNote: Xuất hiện trong bài British Council: Agreeing and disagreeing

cards.definitionEn: A state in which opposing forces harmonise; equilibrium.
cards.exampleEn: Removing the bright border creates a nice visual balance.

cards.meaningVi: sự gia hạn thêm thời gian
cards.definitionEn: The act of extending; a stretching out; enlargement in length or breadth; an increase
cards.exampleEn: Andrea called to ask for a payment extension from 30 to 60 days.
cards.contextNote: Xuất hiện trong bài British Council: A phone call from a customer

cards.meaningVi: sự thỏa hiệp, phương án dung hòa
cards.definitionEn: The settlement of differences by arbitration or by consent reached by mutual concessions.
cards.exampleEn: Both teams reached a fair compromise on the launch scope.

cards.meaningVi: hiệu quả, tối ưu thời gian/nguồn lực
cards.definitionEn: A cause; something that causes an effect
cards.exampleEn: Spaced repetition is an efficient way to retain new vocabulary.

cards.definitionEn: To confer with others in order to come to terms or reach an agreement.
cards.exampleEn: We need to negotiate flexible delivery milestones with the partner.

cards.meaningVi: giảm thiểu, làm dịu bớt (tác động xấu)
cards.definitionEn: To reduce, lessen, or decrease; to make less severe or easier to bear.
cards.exampleEn: Expanding metro lines can significantly mitigate urban traffic congestion.

cards.meaningVi: bền vững, thân thiện dài hạn
cards.definitionEn: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level without depleting resources.
cards.exampleEn: Cities must invest in sustainable public infrastructure.

cards.definitionEn: The basic physical and organizational structures needed for the operation of a society.
cards.exampleEn: Reliable transit infrastructure encourages commuters to leave cars at home.

cards.definitionEn: The state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic.
cards.exampleEn: Peak-hour congestion lowers productivity across major metropolitan areas.

cards.definitionEn: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
cards.exampleEn: Unregulated urban sprawl can exacerbate air pollution.

cards.meaningVi: động lực, chính sách khuyến khích
cards.definitionEn: A thing that motivates or encourages someone to do something.
cards.exampleEn: Tax incentives motivate companies to adopt renewable energy.

cards.meaningVi: sự chênh lệch, bất bình đẳng
cards.definitionEn: A great difference, especially one perceived as unfair.
cards.exampleEn: There is a widening disparity between urban and rural healthcare access.

cards.meaningVi: kiên cường, thích ứng phục hồi nhanh
cards.definitionEn: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
cards.exampleEn: Coastal cities need resilient drainage systems against extreme weather.

cards.definitionEn: Certain to happen; unavoidable.
cards.exampleEn: Automation is an inevitable trend in modern manufacturing.

cards.definitionEn: To distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose.
cards.exampleEn: Municipalities should allocate more funding to green spaces.

cards.meaningVi: sự đồng thuận, thống nhất hướng đi
cards.definitionEn: Arrangement in a straight line or agreement among stakeholders on shared goals.
cards.exampleEn: Let us schedule a 15-minute sync to ensure stakeholder alignment.

cards.definitionEn: Possible to do easily or conveniently.
cards.exampleEn: Shipping all five features this quarter does not look feasible.

cards.definitionEn: A point of congestion in a production system that slows down the whole process.
cards.exampleEn: Manual QA testing became a major bottleneck before launch.

cards.meaningVi: ủy quyền, phân công đầu việc
cards.definitionEn: To entrust a task or responsibility to another person.
cards.exampleEn: Effective managers know when to delegate routine reporting.

cards.meaningVi: chuẩn đối chiếu, thước đo chuẩn
cards.definitionEn: A standard or point of reference against which things may be compared.
cards.exampleEn: We use CEFR B2 fluency as a benchmark for client-facing roles.

cards.meaningVi: tận dụng đòn bẩy, khai thác lợi thế
cards.definitionEn: To use something to maximum advantage.
cards.exampleEn: Teams can leverage AI summaries while keeping human review final.

cards.meaningVi: sự nhất trí chung của tập thể
cards.definitionEn: A general agreement among a group of people.
cards.exampleEn: After a candid debate, the committee reached a consensus.

cards.definitionEn: Able to move quickly and easily; adaptable to rapid change.
cards.exampleEn: Agile working lets teams adjust priorities based on real user feedback.
cards.contextNote: Xuất hiện trong bài British Council: Agile working

cards.definitionEn: To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
cards.exampleEn: We plan to implement the new onboarding flow next Monday.

cards.definitionEn: Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words.
cards.exampleEn: Executive updates should be concise and backed by clear metrics.
